description: Check what an account may do with an ENS name, e.g. 'Can 0xabc… change the records of alice.eth?'. Returns, for each action, true (allowed), false (not allowed) or null (unknown): set records, transfer, set the resolver, create or remove subnames, renew, and more. Also lists burned NameWrapper fuses and, for ENSv2 names, the account's roles. To see who owns or manages the name, use get_name_details.
